title: FileUpload
summary: Dragging a file over the drop zone no longer flickers when the pointer crosses the icon and text, and when the browser can tell the dragged type will not be accepted (MIME-only accept such as image/* or application/pdf) the zone turns red instead of inviting the drop. The error message and added-file rows now actually fade in.
why: Dropzone libraries (react-dropzone, Mantine Dropzone, Untitled UI) track drag enter/leave with a counter because dragleave fires for every child element; a bare onDragLeave made the highlight blink.
react-dropzone and Mantine Dropzone expose accept / reject states during drag using the item MIME types; rejecting before the drop is the less frustrating UX.

scenarioLabels.with-files: With a file (rows now fade/slide in)
scenarioLabels.drag-over: Dragging a csv over a .csv zone: neutral highlight (unchanged)
scenarioLabels.drag-flicker: Pointer crossing children (frame list in the JSON: before it dropped the highlight on each crossing)
scenarioLabels.drag-reject-type: Images-only zone, csv dragged: red tint (before image: old build, always neutral)
scenarioLabels.drag-accept-type: Images-only zone, png dragged: neutral highlight

motion.before: Dropped on every dragleave from a child: flickers while moving over the icon or text
motion.after: Highlight stays until the pointer really leaves (enter/leave counter, reset on drop)
Border and background colour change with the existing 180ms spring transition; the 1.01 scale is not applied while rejecting

motion.before: Fade classes present but never ran (values reset)
motion.after: Message fades in; rows fade in with a 2px slide, 180ms spring (reduced motion: no animation)

states: Drop zone / dragging, accepted or undetectable type: border --semantic-border-accent #27ABB8, fill --semantic-brand-surface, scale 1.01 (unchanged)
Drop zone / dragging, rejected type (new): border --semantic-error-primary #F04438 (dashed, 1px), fill --semantic-error-surface-subtle, no scale
figmaSteps: Add a 'Drag over / reject' variant of the drop zone: dashed 1px border --semantic-error-primary #F04438, fill --semantic-error-surface-subtle (#FEF3F2-tone token), no scale change (the accepted drag variant keeps scale 101%).

Annotate the rule: red only when the accept list is MIME types only (image/*, application/pdf) and a dragged item's type matches none of them; with extension rules (.csv) the zone stays in the neutral drag state because the browser hides file names during a drag.
Annotate: the drag highlight remains while the pointer moves over the icon tile and text (no flicker).
notes: Not done this pass, proposed follow-up: per-file progress rows (progress bar and cancel while uploading). The component only holds files locally today, so progress needs an upload callback in the API.
Browsers expose only the MIME type (not the name or size) while dragging, and Safari/Firefox may report an empty type for some files; an empty type never triggers the red state.
The before images for the two reject scenarios were taken on the old build, which had no type detection: any dragged file showed the neutral highlight.

The drag-flicker scenario reads the highlight after synthetic dragenter/dragleave events in the order Chrome fires them when the pointer crosses between children; evals hold the per-step border colours.

The drag-flicker before sequence was recorded from a temporary copy of the previous component (read from classes after each event group, 40ms apart): the highlight dropped to false on `zone -> icon` and `icon -> text` crossings and returned on the next dragover; after, it stays true until the real leave.
